design.singleAuthority: learning/source/reuse records are ACADEMY_* entries in the existing Work OS hash-chained journal (same lock, same chain, tenant scope, idempotency); no second store, no second registry
design.lifecycle: GAP_DETECTED -> SOURCE_DISCOVERY -> SOURCE_SCREENED -> CURRICULUM_DRAFTED -> CANDIDATE_PROPOSED -> LAB_EXPERIMENT_RUNNING -> LAB_RESULT_RECORDED -> AWAITING_INDEPENDENT_REVIEW -> PROMOTED_KNOWLEDGE | PROMOTED_SKILL_CANDIDATE | REJECTED; promoted -> STALE | RECERTIFY_REQUIRED | REVOKED; STALE -> RECERTIFY_REQUIRED | REVOKED; RECERTIFY_REQUIRED -> REVOKED
design.promotion: explicit promote() only; reviewer identity must differ (normalized) from implementer and creator; promoter actor must not be the implementer; reviewer evidence file re-verified by sha256 and content (learningId, roleId, verdict APPROVED, reviewer, implementer, kind, TENANT/GLOBAL scope); permissionDelta always empty; executable false; authorityEffect NONE; registry proficiency/certification untouched
design.sources: content is screened as data and never stored in the journal; supporting source requires sha256, trust != UNTRUSTED, ACTIVE, screened clean (hash-bound content without injection findings), fresh (fetchedAt + TTL); a cited revoked/poisoned/flagged source blocks promotion
design.tenancy: tenant-scoped reads/writes; other tenants get NOT_FOUND/undefined; global promotion requires global + anonymized + GLOBAL-scoped reviewer evidence + global (public URL) supporting sources; other tenants only see a generalized projection
design.drift: pure computeDrift over records + current model/tool-adapter/source state + reviewer-evidence re-verification; revocation cascades to dependent promoted records; in-flight dependents cannot promote
design.recertificationPath: not implemented in this package (RECERTIFY_REQUIRED/STALE only move to REVOKED); deferred to a later governed package

Same rule used in reviewerIsIndependent, promotionProblem (actor: PROMOTER_IDENTITY_INVALID / PROMOTER_IS_IMPLEMENTER) and verifyReviewerEvidence (canonical match + new CONTENT_SELF_REVIEW when the file's reviewer and implementer share a key).
